_doc: Screenshot registry. `src` is relative to the repo's game-assets/ folder. Run `node scripts/media.mjs` after editing to (re)generate /public/media. `press: true` also exports a full-size JPG into the press kit. Alt text describes what is visible — never invent mechanics in it.
